Class CameraHeadingCheck

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.checks.CameraHeadingCheck
All Implemented Interfaces:
Check
public final class CameraHeadingCheck extends Object implements Check
Every camera that solves a full pose from tags agrees on the robot's heading, with the gyro and with each other.

For each multi-tag frame the caller passes the camera's heading and the gyro's yaw at the same moment. The difference is the camera's offset from the gyro, which stays constant while the robot turns, so frames from different moments and cameras can be compared. Each camera's offset is the median over the last WINDOW_SECONDS. A wrong mount yaw shifts one camera's offset by the error: TXMAN1 Q30's flipped yaw sign put LL-Left 172 deg from LL-Back, and the pose was seeded backwards from it.

The check fails when two cameras' offsets differ by more than FAIL_DEG, or once the pose heading has been seeded, when a camera's offset differs from the fused heading's by that much. It cannot tell which camera of a disagreeing pair is wrong; it names both. Only multi-tag frames count: a single tag's heading can flip, and MegaTag2-style solves take the heading from the robot, so they must not be passed in.

Only a camera the robot fuses can fail the check. One that is only logged (a SystemCore camera with a placeholder mount, an Orin camera switched off) warns at most: its heading cannot move the pose, so it is no reason to call the robot NO-GO.

    • HOLD_SECONDS

      public static final double HOLD_SECONDS
      A worse verdict must last this long before it is reported. While the windows refill after the heading changes under the cameras (in the simulator, the robot placed without its gyro turning), cameras' medians flip at different moments and briefly disagree; a wrong mount disagrees for good.

      public void addFrame(String camera, double cameraHeadingDeg, double gyroYawDeg, int tagCount, double yawRateRadPerSec, double now)
      Records one camera frame. Ignored unless it saw two or more tags and the robot was turning slower than MAX_YAW_RATE.
      Parameters:
      camera - the camera's name
      cameraHeadingDeg - the robot heading the camera solved
      gyroYawDeg - the gyro's yaw at the frame
      tagCount - tags in the solve
      yawRateRadPerSec - the robot's turn rate now
      now - this loop's robot time

    • addFrame

      public void addFrame(String camera, boolean cameraFused, double cameraHeadingDeg, double gyroYawDeg, int tagCount, double yawRateRadPerSec, double now)
      Records one camera frame, saying whether the robot fuses that camera. Ignored unless it saw two or more tags and the robot was turning slower than MAX_YAW_RATE.
      Parameters:
      camera - the camera's name
      cameraFused - whether any of the camera's sources is fused into the pose now
      cameraHeadingDeg - the robot heading the camera solved
      gyroYawDeg - the gyro's yaw at the frame
      tagCount - tags in the solve
      yawRateRadPerSec - the robot's turn rate now
      now - this loop's robot time
